# Arkansas Automated

> Arkansas Automated runs in-person AI workshops and done-for-you automation builds for Arkansas small businesses. Public workshop seats run Saturday afternoons in Fort Smith ($497 early bird). Done-for-you services include a 24/7 AI front desk ($2,500 setup + $497/mo), a fixed-price AI operations audit ($999), workflow automation builds ($1,500-$5,000 setup), and an embedded on-site retainer (from $2,000/mo). Workshop and audit fees credit toward any build started within 60 days. Based in Fort Smith, serving all of Arkansas.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://arkansasautomated.com/): workshops, done-for-you services, FAQ, and the reservation form
- [AI receptionist by city](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist): 25 Arkansas cities, each with the local phone and front-desk detail
- [Services and pricing](https://arkansasautomated.com/services): all engagement types with public pricing
- [Vendra](https://arkansasautomated.com/vendra): shopping-center sales reporting for malls and merchants. An Arkansas Automated product. Activation uses a store-specific /join/[token] link issued by the mall team.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://arkansasautomated.com/pricing.md): structured price sheet for AI agents
- [Problems we fix](https://arkansasautomated.com/fix): missed calls, after-hours calls, quote follow-up, double entry, no-shows
- [Forward deployed AI engineer](https://arkansasautomated.com/forward-deployed-ai-engineer): what embedded AI implementation means for a local business
- [AI workshops by city](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-workshops): 25 Arkansas cities with local details
- [Automation by industry](https://arkansasautomated.com/for): plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, dentists, law firms, real estate, clinics, auto repair, landscapers
- [Guides](https://arkansasautomated.com/learn): plain-language answers on AI receptionists, costs, and automation

## Key locations

Every city below has an AI receptionist page at /ai-receptionist/[city] and a workshops page at /ai-workshops/[city].

- River Valley: [Fort Smith](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fort-smith) (home base, public workshops), Van Buren, Russellville
- Northwest Arkansas: [Fayetteville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fayetteville), Springdale, [Rogers](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/rogers), [Bentonville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/bentonville), Bella Vista, Siloam Springs
- Central Arkansas: [Little Rock](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/little-rock), North Little Rock, [Conway](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/conway), Jacksonville, Cabot, Benton, Bryant, Hot Springs, Searcy
- Northeast Arkansas and the Delta: Jonesboro, Paragould, Batesville, West Memphis
- South and Southwest Arkansas: Texarkana, El Dorado, Pine Bluff
